1.t: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “It has been revealed to me that a group of jinn listened ˹to the Quran,˺ and said ˹to their fellow jinn˺: ‘Indeed, we have heard a wondrous recitation
1.tr: Qul oohiya ilaiya annna hustama'a nafarum minal jinni faqaalooo innaa sami'naa quraanan ajaba

2.t: It leads to Right Guidance so we believed in it, and we will never associate anyone with our Lord ˹in worship˺
2.tr: Yahdeee ilar rushdi fa-aamannaa bihee Wa-lan nushrika bi-rabbinaaa 'ahada

3.t: ˹Now, we believe that˺ our Lord—Exalted is His Majesty—has neither taken a mate nor offspring
3.tr: Wa-annahoo Ta'aalaa jaddu Rabbinaa maat takhaza saahibatanw Wa-laa walada

4.t: and that the foolish of us used to utter ˹outrageous˺ falsehoods about Allah
4.tr: Wa-annahoo kaana yaqoolu safeehunaa 'al allahi shatata

5.t: We certainly thought that humans and jinn would never speak lies about Allah
5.tr: Wa-annaa zanannaaa al lan taqoolal insu wal-jinnu 'al allahi kaziba

6.t: And some men used to seek refuge with some jinn—so they increased each other in wickedness
6.tr: Wa-annahoo kaana rijaalun minal insi ya'oozoona bi-rijaalin minal jinni fa-zaadoohum rahaqa

7.t: And those ˹humans˺ thought, just like you ˹jinn˺, that Allah would not resurrect anyone ˹for judgment˺
7.tr: Wa-annahum zannoo kamaa zanantum al lany yab'asal laahu 'ahada

8.t: ˹Earlier˺ we tried to reach heaven ˹for news˺, only to find it filled with stern guards and shooting stars
8.tr: Wa-annaa lamasnas samaaa'a fa-wajadnaahaa muli'at harasan shadeedanw Wa-shuhuba

9.t: We used to take up positions there for eavesdropping, but whoever dares eavesdrop now will find a flare lying in wait for them
9.tr: Wa-annaa kunnaa naq'udu minhaa maqaa'ida lis'sam'i famany yastami'il 'aana yajid lahoo shihaabar rasada

10.t: Now, we have no clue whether evil is intended for those on earth, or their Lord intends for them what is right
10.tr: Wa-annaa laa nadreee asharrun ureeda biman fil ardi 'am 'araada bihim rabbuhum rashada

11.t: Among us are those who are righteous and those who are less so. We have been of different factions
11.tr: Wa-annaa minnas saalihoona Wa-minnaa doona zaalika kunnaa taraaa'iqa qidada

12.t: ˹Now,˺ we truly know that we cannot frustrate Allah on earth, nor can we escape from Him ˹into heaven˺
12.tr: Wa-annaa zanan-naaa al lan nu'jizal laaha fil ardi Wa-lan nu'jizahoo haraba

13.t: When we heard the guidance ˹of the Quran˺, we ˹readily˺ believed in it. For whoever believes in their Lord will have no fear of being denied ˹a reward˺ or wronged
13.tr: Wa-annaa lammaa sami'nal hudaaa aamannaa bihee famany yu'min bi-rabbihee falaa yakhaafu bakhsanw Wa-laa rahaqa

14.t: And among us are those who have submitted ˹to Allah˺ and those who are deviant. So ˹as for˺ those who submitted, it is they who have attained Right Guidance
14.tr: Wa-annaa minnal muslimoona Wa-minnal qaasitoona faman aslama fa-ulaaa'ika taharraw rashada

15.t: And as for the deviant, they will be fuel for Hell.’”

16.t: Had the deniers followed the Right Way, We would have certainly granted them abundant rain to drink—
16.tr: Wa-alla-wis taqaamoo 'alat tareeqati la-asqaynaahum maa'an ghadaqa

17.t: as a test for them. And whoever turns away from the remembrance of their Lord will be admitted by Him into an overwhelming punishment
17.tr: Linaftinahum feeh; Wa-many yu'rid 'an zikri rabbihee yasluk-hu 'azaaban sa'ada

18.t: The places of worship are ˹only˺ for Allah, so do not invoke anyone besides Him
18.tr: Wa-annal masaajida lil-laahi falaa tad'oo ma'al laahi 'ahada

19.t: Yet when the servant of Allah stood up calling upon Him ˹alone˺, the pagans almost swarmed over him
19.tr: Wa-annahoo lammaa qaama 'abdul laahi yad'oohu kaadoo yakoonoona 'alaihi libada

20.t: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “I call only upon my Lord, associating none with Him ˹in worship˺.”
20.tr: Qul innamaaa ad'oo rabbee Wa-laaa ushriku biheee 'ahada

21.t: Say, “It is not in my power to harm or benefit you.”
21.tr: Qul innee laaa amliku lakum darranw Wa-laa rashada

22.t: Say, “No one can protect me from Allah ˹if I were to disobey Him˺, nor can I find any refuge other than Him
22.tr: Qul innee lany yujeeranee minal laahi 'ahadunw, Wa-lan ajida min doonihee multahada

23.t: ˹My duty is˺ only to convey ˹the truth˺ from Allah and ˹deliver˺ His messages.” And whoever disobeys Allah and His Messenger will certainly be in the Fire of Hell, to stay there for ever and ever
23.tr: Illaa balaagham minal laahi Wa-risaalaatih; Wa-many ya'sil laaha Wa-rasoolahoo fa-inna lahoo naara jahannama khaalideena feehaaa 'abada

24.t: Only when they see what they have been threatened with will they know who is weaker in helpers and inferior in manpower
24.tr: Hattaaa izaa ra-aw maa yoo'adoona fasaya'lamoona man ad'afu naasiranw Wa-aqallu 'adada

25.t: Say, “I do not know if what you are promised is near or my Lord has set a distant time for it
25.tr: Qul in adreee a-qareebum maa too'adoona am yaj'alu lahoo rabbeee 'amada

26.t: ˹He is the˺ Knower of the unseen, disclosing none of it to anyone
26.tr: Aalimul ghaibi falaa yuzhiru alaa ghaibiheee 'ahada

27.t: except messengers of His choice. Then He appoints angel-guards before and behind them
27.tr: Illaa manir tadaa mir rasoolin fa-innahoo yasluku min baini yadaihi Wa-min khalfihee rasada

28.t: to ensure that the messengers fully deliver the messages of their Lord—though He ˹already˺ knows all about them, and keeps account of everything.”
28.tr: Liya'lama an qad ablaghoo risaalaati rabbihim Wa-ahaata bi-maa ladaihim Wa-ahsaa kulla shai'in 'adada
